verdict.rationale: The Working Copy manual says users can stash and unstash from the repository context menu, so the product itself delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single thin first-party mention with no further detail. Missing for 10: documentation of stash depth (multiple stash entries, naming, partial or untracked-file stashing, conflict handling on unstash), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory

citations.quote: You Stash and Unstash from the context menu of repositories.
